# commit amend --fill reads the active worktree's commit and message draft.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-06T18:00:00Z'

mkdir repo
cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Primary checkout message'
gs repo init
git worktree add -b linked ../linked
cd ../linked
gs branch track
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Linked checkout message'

git config spice.message.fill.command mock-message
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RESPONSE=$WORK/message.txt
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RECORD=$WORK/invocation

git rev-parse HEAD
cp stdout $WORK/before.txt
gs --no-prompt commit amend --fill --allow-empty --no-restack --no-edit
stderr 'Generator diagnostic'
cmp $WORK/invocation/head $WORK/before.txt
grep '^Linked checkout message$' $WORK/invocation/subject
grep '^Linked checkout message$' $WORK/invocation/draft
grep '^commit-amend$' $WORK/invocation/operation
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^Generated in linked checkout$'

cd ../repo
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^Primary checkout message$'

cd ../linked

# An explicit amendment message bypasses the configured command.
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=8
gs commit amend --fill --allow-empty -m 'Explicit amendment'
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^Explicit amendment$'

-- message.txt --
Generated in linked checkout
